title: Neuro Anticheat
description: Lightweight and practical anti-cheat plugin for Purpur/Paper 1.21.8.Designed for SMP servers that need a simple, configurable baseline protection without heavy setup.
body:
NeuroAntiCheat
Lightweight and practical anti-cheat plugin for Purpur/Paper 1.21.8.
Designed for SMP servers that need a simple, configurable baseline protection without heavy setup.

Features
Speed check
Detects abnormal horizontal movement and can apply setback.
Fly check
Detects suspicious continuous air movement and can apply setback.
AutoClicker (CPS) check
Flags unrealistic click-per-second values.
Violation system
per-player violation level (VL),
automatic VL decay over time,
auto-kick when threshold is reached.
Staff alerts
sends alerts to players with permission.
Admin command
/nac reload to reload config without restart.
Bypass permission
allow trusted players/staff to skip checks.
Compatibility
Server software: Purpur / Paper
Minecraft version: 1.21.8
Java: 21
Commands
/nac reload — reload plugin config
Permissions
neuroanticheat.admin — receive alerts and use admin command
neuroanticheat.bypass — bypass all checks
Configuration
Main settings are in config.yml:

violations.max-before-kick — kick threshold
violations.decay-seconds / decay-amount — VL decay logic
checks.speed.* — speed check tuning
checks.fly.* — fly check tuning
checks.autoclicker.max-cps — CPS limit
alerts.notify-permission — who receives alerts
Notes
NeuroAntiCheat is intentionally lightweight.
It focuses on stable, low-overhead checks suitable for everyday SMP moderation.

If you want, I can also write:

a short Modrinth summary (1-2 lines),
a full changelog format for versions,
a ready-to-paste FAQ section for false positives/config tuning.
